sloka: रामो ऽपि मुनिभिः सार्धं पार्थिवैश्च महात्मभिः ।श्रुत्वा तद्गीतिमाधुर्यं कर्मशालामुपागमत् ।। ७.९४.३१ ॥
transliteration: rāmo 'pi munibhiḥ sārdhaṁ pārthivaiśca mahātmabhiḥ ।śrutvā tadgītimādhuryaṁ karmaśālāmupāgamat ।। 7.94.31 ॥

translations.english: Rama, accompanied by great-souled sages and kings, approached the sacrificial hall after hearing the sweetness of their song.
